title: Senior Data Scientist/AI Engineer
description:
Role Overview

KPIT is seeking a highly skilled, hands-on Senior Data Scientist / AI Engineer (Remote) to architect, develop, and deliver end-to-end Machine Learning and AI solutions within the Azure ecosystem.


The successful candidate will be responsible for the entire AI lifecycle—from designing scalable data pipelines to deploying production-grade AI agents capable of complex, multi-step reasoning. This role is ideal for an engineer who excels at bridging the gap between experimental data science and robust, scalable MLOps.


Key Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Solution Delivery: Own the full lifecycle of AI/ML solutions, from initial problem definition and data acquisition to production deployment and monitoring.
  • Data Engineering & Pipeline Development: Build and maintain high-performance, scalable data pipelines using PySpark and Spark on Azure Databricks.
  • Model Development & Feature Engineering: Perform advanced feature engineering, data preparation, and sophisticated model development for diverse business use cases.
  • Agentic AI & GenAI: Develop and deploy AI agents and workflows utilizing multi-step reasoning, tool usage, and Generative AI frameworks.
  • MLOps & Lifecycle Management: Implement and manage MLflow for experiment tracking; monitor model performance, data drift, and system reliability in production environments.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Business, Data Engineering, and Analytics teams to translate business requirements into technical AI solutions.
  • Technical Leadership: Act as a subject matter expert, mentoring junior team members and driving engineering best practices.


Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Programming & Data: Expert-level proficiency in Python and SQL.
  • Big Data & Cloud: Strong hands-on experience with PySpark, Apache Spark, and Azure Databricks.
  • Machine Learning: Deep understanding of ML workflows, model evaluation techniques, and statistical modeling.
  • MLOps: Practical experience with MLflow and fundamental MLOps principles (CI/CD for ML, model versioning, and monitoring).
  • Generative AI: Proven exposure to Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or AutoGen).
  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.


Experience Requirements

  • Professional Experience: 5–6 years of hands-on experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, or AI Engineering.
  • Production Experience: A proven track record of deploying and maintaining ML/AI models in a production environment.
  • Cloud Expertise: Extensive experience working within cloud environments, specifically Microsoft Azure.


About KPIT

KPIT is a global partner to the automotive and mobility ecosystem. We deliver end-to-end engineering, data, and AI-led digital transformation solutions to leading Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) and Tier-1 suppliers worldwide, shaping the future of mobility.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Exciting New Career Opportunity: Software Engineer - Quality & AI Infrastructure

Company: Hirebus

Location: Remote in Brazil

Pay: $30K-$60K per year


We're hiring a mid-level engineer to own two things: the quality of our codebase and the early foundations of our AI agent work.


The role

Most of your time will be spent making our existing software more reliable. You'll dig into production bugs, trace them to root cause, and write the tests that should have caught them. You'll review pull requests in a way that raises the bar without demoralizing anyone. You'll tackle the tech debt that everyone complains about in retros but nobody picks up.


The other part — and this is growing — is our AI agent work. We're building tooling, orchestration, and evaluation systems for LLM-powered features. This isn't a research project. It's production software that needs the same rigor as everything else we ship. We need someone who can bring that rigor.


What you'll do

  • Debug and fix issues across the stack, from staging through production
  • Build meaningful test coverage (the kind that actually catches regressions)
  • Review code thoroughly — with context, not just style nits
  • Refactor the parts of the codebase that slow the team down
  • Help define how we ship: observability, release process, quality gates
  • Work with product and design to land features cleanly
  • Contribute to our AI agent infrastructure: tool-calling, orchestration, evaluation, safety


Technical Requirements

  • 7+ years of professional engineering experience with a track record of shipping production SaaS products
  • Expert in Node.js, React, and TypeScript with strong product architecture instincts (scalability, maintainability, speed of iteration)
  • Hands-on Supabase experience: Postgres schema design, RLS policies, edge functions, and auth
  • Shipped production LLM-powered features (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) with a working understanding of prompt engineering, evals, latency/cost tradeoffs, and guardrails
  • Experience building agentic workflows, RAG systems, or tool-use integrations (MCP, function calling)
  • Excellent written English and self-directed async work style, with meaningful overlap with US Mountain Time
  • Comfortable using AI-native development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) as part of daily workflow


Your first 90 days:

  • Month 1: You've shipped real bug fixes. You're in the PR review rotation and contributing useful feedback. You have context on the parts of the system that break most often.
  • Month 2: Test coverage in your area has improved measurably. You've identified at least one chunk of tech debt worth prioritizing and started on it.
  • Month 3: You've shipped a meaningful refactor. You've made your first contributions to the AI agent infrastructure — something concrete, with results we can point to.


We're not looking for someone who wants to rewrite everything from scratch. We want someone who makes the team steadily better — through reliable fixes, honest reviews, and the kind of infrastructure work that compounds over time. If you're also curious about what engineering looks like as AI agents become part of the workflow, even better.

title: PROFESSOR AUXILIAR DE INGLÊS CORPORATIVO ONLINE - HOME OFFICE
description:
PROFESSOR AUXILIAR DE INGLÊS CORPORATIVO ONLINE - HOME OFFICE


LEIA COM ATENÇÃO:

NÃO SE CANDIDATE CASO NÃO POSSUA EXPERIÊNCIA COM ENSINO DE INGLÊS CORPORATIVO. CANDIDATURAS FORA DO PERFIL SERÃO DESCARTADAS


Estamos em busca dos melhores professores de inglês corporativo, dedicados e comprometidos, que desejam contribuir para o desenvolvimento de carreira dos nossos alunos. Oferecemos remuneração acima do mercado, estabilidade e plano de carreira. Vaga perfeita para professores que buscam crescimento profissional.


Função:

  • Auxiliar o professor principal na ministração de aulas online;
  • Auxiliar na aplicação e correção de provas e assignments;
  • Colaborar na elaboração e correção de materiais didáticos;
  • Oferecer suporte no feedback aos alunos;
  • Substituir professores regulares se necessário;


Pré-requisitos:

  • Possuir notebook, iluminação adequada, internet estável e local apropriado para lecionar;
  • Inglês \"fluente\" ou \"nativo\", com sólido conhecimento de vocabulário e expressões empresariais;
  • Experiência no ensino de língua inglesa para adultos;
  • Pontualidade, proatividade, colaboração, organização, boa comunicação, relacionamento interpessoal e trabalho em equipe.


Indispensável:

  • Experiência internacional em país de língua inglesa;
  • Formação superior nas áreas de Business;
  • Disponibilidade para turmas aos sábados pela manhã;


*Não serão aceitas candidaturas fora do perfil desejável.


Carga horária:  4 horas/aula diárias.


Modelo de contratação e benefícios

A contratação inicia-se no cargo de Professor Auxiliar, com um período de adaptação de aproximadamente 2 a 3 meses, durante o qual será avaliada a adequação do professor à metodologia da escola e aos padrões pedagógicos adotados.


Após esse período, havendo bom desempenho e alinhamento metodológico, o professor poderá ser efetivado como Professor Oficial. A partir da efetivação, o profissional passa a ter direito ao benefício de plano de saúde, além das demais condições previstas no plano de carreira.

title: SAP Consultant
description:
About the Role


The SAP MDG (Material Master Data) Consultant is responsible for designing, configuring, enhancing, and supporting SAP MDG function for all types of master data, and its integration with S/4HANA and other applications across global enterprises. The role ensures data governance, master data quality, workflow enforcement and compliance with business rules. This key role focuses on providing technology solutions for business requirements, providing global design and localization as warranted, stabilizing and enhancing the existing solutions, resolving defects, production break-fixes, as well as providing recommendation regarding optimal business processes by leveraging SAP best practices. This person will collaborate with the Product Owner, Project managers, system architects and the business partners to understand key objectives and challenges, ensure successful outcomes, and provide the right direction in the dynamic business environment.



Responsibilities



  • Serve as the subject matter expert for solution development in the SAP MDG area
  • Design, configure, and implement SAP MDG solutions for domains such as Business Partner, Customer, Vendor, Material, and Finance.
  • Lead end-to-end MDG implementations, including requirements gathering, blueprinting, configuration, testing, and go-live support
  • Configure MDG data models, change request types, workflows, business rules, validations, and derivations
  • Integrate SAP MDG with ECC, S/4HANA, and non-SAP systems
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to define data governance processes, roles, and policies
  • Support data migration, data cleansing, and data quality initiatives
  • Configure and support BRF+, Workflow (WS-BPEL/Flexible Workflow), DRF, and UI (Fiori/Web Dynpro)
  • Perform configuration of systems and manage transport as part of ITSM, Cloud ALM, and change management across the SAP landscape
  • Provide production support, issue resolution, and continuous improvement enhancements
  • Create functional and technical documentation, including design specs, test scripts, and user guides
  • Support user training and knowledge transfer activities to the managed service team.
  • Ensure compliance with data standards, audit requirements, and best practices
  • Perform Functional Unit testing, Product testing, System integration testing, cross functional testing, testing of SAP upgrades, Performance testing, etc.
  • Support UAT, provide user training and support change management and business enablement.
  • Manage and maintain overall solution architecture, scalability, and integrity.
  • Provides hands-on support to developers (e.g., resolving technical blockers and reviewing code)
  • Other job duties and projects as assigned.


Qualifications



  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
  • 5+ years of experience in SAP Master Data Governance


Required Skills



  • Strong hands-on experience with SAP MDG-BP, MDG-M, MDG-F, or MDG-S.
  • Experience with SAP S/4HANA integration and other SAAS and non-SAP systems.
  • Solid understanding of data governance frameworks and master data lifecycle
  • Experience configuring: Data Models & Change Request Types, BRF+ Rules, Workflow, Data Replication Framework (DRF)
  • Knowledge of Fiori apps and MDG UI customization
  • Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including data analysts, IT, and business stakeholders, to ensure seamless integration and alignment of MDG solutions.
  • Training and Support: Provide training and support to team members and end-users on MDG best practices and solutions.
  • Provide regular reports on system health and performance.
  • Knowledge of agile methodologies and frameworks such as Kanban as well as use of tools like Jira and Service Now.
  • Facilitate work and resource estimation, track progress, provide escalations and status updates.


Preferred Skills



  • SAP MDG Certification

title: Sr Software Engineer
description:
Buscamos uma pessoa Senior Software Engineer com forte experiência em Python/FastAPI para liderar tecnicamente o desenvolvimento de novas features, integrações e a evolução arquitetural da nossa plataforma.

Esperamos alguém que tome decisões arquiteturais, defina padrões para o time, mentore engenheiros menos sêniores e trabalhe lado a lado com fundadores e CTO em decisões de produto e infraestrutura.


Sobre a empresa

Somos uma startup de Agentic AI atuando no varejo enterprise no Brasil. Construímos agentes que operam 24/7 em produção, processando volume relevante para grandes redes. Estamos em fase de escala — cada decisão arquitetural tomada hoje impacta nossa capacidade de crescer nos próximos 18-24 meses.


Mais detalhes sobre clientes, parcerias e roadmap são compartilhados durante o processo seletivo, essa é uma oportunidade de trabalhar com IA para as maiores empresa do Brasil.


Responsabilidades


  • Liderar tecnicamente a evolução do backend da plataforma
  • Desenhar e implementar sistemas distribuídos escaláveis em produção
  • Arquitetar integrações críticas com sistemas de terceiros
  • Definir padrões de código, testes e observabilidade do time
  • Mentorar engenheiros pleno e júnior, elevando a barra técnica
  • Trabalhar com CTO e fundadores em decisões arquiteturais de longo prazo
  • Garantir confiabilidade, performance e segurança de sistemas transacionais



Stack


  • Linguagem: Python
  • Framework: FastAPI
  • Infraestrutura: Google Cloud Platform
  • Banco de dados: PostgreSQL
  • Práticas: observabilidade ponta a ponta, CI/CD, evals para sistemas não-determinísticos



Perfil Ideal

title: Software Engineer
description:
Exciting New Career Opportunity: Software Engineer - Quality & AI Infrastructure

Company: Hirebus

Location: Remote in Brazil

Pay: $30K-$60K per year


We're hiring a mid-level engineer to own two things: the quality of our codebase and the early foundations of our AI agent work.


The role

Most of your time will be spent making our existing software more reliable. You'll dig into production bugs, trace them to root cause, and write the tests that should have caught them. You'll review pull requests in a way that raises the bar without demoralizing anyone. You'll tackle the tech debt that everyone complains about in retros but nobody picks up.


The other part — and this is growing — is our AI agent work. We're building tooling, orchestration, and evaluation systems for LLM-powered features. This isn't a research project. It's production software that needs the same rigor as everything else we ship. We need someone who can bring that rigor.


What you'll do

  • Debug and fix issues across the stack, from staging through production
  • Build meaningful test coverage (the kind that actually catches regressions)
  • Review code thoroughly — with context, not just style nits
  • Refactor the parts of the codebase that slow the team down
  • Help define how we ship: observability, release process, quality gates
  • Work with product and design to land features cleanly
  • Contribute to our AI agent infrastructure: tool-calling, orchestration, evaluation, safety


Technical Requirements

  • 7+ years of professional engineering experience with a track record of shipping production SaaS products
  • Expert in Node.js, React, and TypeScript with strong product architecture instincts (scalability, maintainability, speed of iteration)
  • Hands-on Supabase experience: Postgres schema design, RLS policies, edge functions, and auth
  • Shipped production LLM-powered features (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) with a working understanding of prompt engineering, evals, latency/cost tradeoffs, and guardrails
  • Experience building agentic workflows, RAG systems, or tool-use integrations (MCP, function calling)
  • Excellent written English and self-directed async work style, with meaningful overlap with US Mountain Time
  • Comfortable using AI-native development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) as part of daily workflow


Your first 90 days:

  • Month 1: You've shipped real bug fixes. You're in the PR review rotation and contributing useful feedback. You have context on the parts of the system that break most often.
  • Month 2: Test coverage in your area has improved measurably. You've identified at least one chunk of tech debt worth prioritizing and started on it.
  • Month 3: You've shipped a meaningful refactor. You've made your first contributions to the AI agent infrastructure — something concrete, with results we can point to.


We're not looking for someone who wants to rewrite everything from scratch. We want someone who makes the team steadily better — through reliable fixes, honest reviews, and the kind of infrastructure work that compounds over time. If you're also curious about what engineering looks like as AI agents become part of the workflow, even better.

title: Senior Business Analyst (Healthcare Marketing)
description:
One of our clients, a USA Healthcare Commercialization firm, is looking for a Senior Business Analyst with experience in SOWs and Project Finance. This role would be focused on their Speaker Bureau operations (organization of medical conferences and congresses).


The Sr. Business Analyst is responsible for managing financial and operational aspects of assigned clients and their products. This role requires a high level of understanding of the assigned clients and products, various speaker bureau project types, and the ability to work independently.


The Sr. Business Analyst works closely with the Director and financial analysts to ensure accurate internal and external financial reporting, develop budget proposals and provide financial related support in client meetings.


Financial


● Oversee day-to-day financial operations for speaker bureau, including budget tracking, internal revenue accruals, forecasting and variance analysis.

● Develops Statement of Work (SOW), ensuring final sign-off by Director as required.

● Create and manage budgets and proposals, providing oversight for complex SOWs. Prepare speaker bureau specific budgets, accrual reports and monthly financial management updates

● Work closely with program directors on monthly accrual reports, reviewing and discussing as needed.

● Ensure accuracy in financial reconciliation data before releasing reports to clients

● Generate and distribute monthly accruals and budget reports for clients

● Provide invoicing amounts to Accounts Receivable to facilitate timely invoice submissions


Operational


● Ensures compliance with internal Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and client specific SOPs.

● Provides budget related support in client meetings as needed.

● Participates in accrual meetings with clients based on their SOPs.

● Contributes to process improvement initiatives to enhance financial operations.


Experience and Skills


● 2+ Years experience in budgeting · Proficiency in Excel functions for financial modeling and analysis.

● Strong financial analysis skills, including budget tracking, forecasting and variance analysis · Excellent understanding of internal SOPs and ability to ensure compliance

● Familiar with all internal and external SOPs.

● Strives to find process efficiencies by thinking outside the box and making recommendations for change.

● Knowledge of ERP systems, NetSuite a plus

● Excellent client facing skills, including comfortability with all types of client communications.

● Prior speaker bureau experience a plus

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Company Description

Vancouver Institute, a prestigious educational institution, excels in English language teaching, offering high-quality, immersive learning experiences to help students achieve fluency and confidence in English. 


With 17 years of experience and over 5,000 students taught, it now provides online English Immersion in a virtual format for young and adult learners. 


Role Description

The Institute is currently seeking a dedicated and enthusiastic English teacher for a fully remote role. Responsibilities include delivering engaging English lessons, preparing customized lesson plans, and supporting adult students in achieving their language goals.


Teachers will teach English according to each level and assess student progress, provide constructive feedback, and encourage interactivity in online classrooms via Google Meet.


Qualifications

  • Candidates should possess strong expertise in English teaching for any student level (A1 to C2) and online teaching approaches;
  • Experience in lesson planning tailored to diverse learning styles;
  • Proficient communication skills and the ability to engage students effectively in a virtual setting;
  • Virtual instruction experience or immersion programs is advantageous;
  • TEFL, TESOL, CELTA, or equivalent certifications are desirable;
  • A degree in Education, Letters, Linguistics, or related fields has weight;
  • A passion for teaching and creating a positive e-learning atmosphere is crucial, along with familiarity with online teaching tools.


Availability

Availability is required from Monday to Friday for at least one full shift during mornings, afternoons, or evenings. This is a temporary position starting in June, with the possibility of contract renewal.

title: SAP Consultant
description:
About the Role


The SAP MDG (Material Master Data) Consultant is responsible for designing, configuring, enhancing, and supporting SAP MDG function for all types of master data, and its integration with S/4HANA and other applications across global enterprises. The role ensures data governance, master data quality, workflow enforcement and compliance with business rules. This key role focuses on providing technology solutions for business requirements, providing global design and localization as warranted, stabilizing and enhancing the existing solutions, resolving defects, production break-fixes, as well as providing recommendation regarding optimal business processes by leveraging SAP best practices. This person will collaborate with the Product Owner, Project managers, system architects and the business partners to understand key objectives and challenges, ensure successful outcomes, and provide the right direction in the dynamic business environment.



Responsibilities



  • Serve as the subject matter expert for solution development in the SAP MDG area
  • Design, configure, and implement SAP MDG solutions for domains such as Business Partner, Customer, Vendor, Material, and Finance.
  • Lead end-to-end MDG implementations, including requirements gathering, blueprinting, configuration, testing, and go-live support
  • Configure MDG data models, change request types, workflows, business rules, validations, and derivations
  • Integrate SAP MDG with ECC, S/4HANA, and non-SAP systems
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to define data governance processes, roles, and policies
  • Support data migration, data cleansing, and data quality initiatives
  • Configure and support BRF+, Workflow (WS-BPEL/Flexible Workflow), DRF, and UI (Fiori/Web Dynpro)
  • Perform configuration of systems and manage transport as part of ITSM, Cloud ALM, and change management across the SAP landscape
  • Provide production support, issue resolution, and continuous improvement enhancements
  • Create functional and technical documentation, including design specs, test scripts, and user guides
  • Support user training and knowledge transfer activities to the managed service team.
  • Ensure compliance with data standards, audit requirements, and best practices
  • Perform Functional Unit testing, Product testing, System integration testing, cross functional testing, testing of SAP upgrades, Performance testing, etc.
  • Support UAT, provide user training and support change management and business enablement.
  • Manage and maintain overall solution architecture, scalability, and integrity.
  • Provides hands-on support to developers (e.g., resolving technical blockers and reviewing code)
  • Other job duties and projects as assigned.


Qualifications



  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
  • 5+ years of experience in SAP Master Data Governance


Required Skills



  • Strong hands-on experience with SAP MDG-BP, MDG-M, MDG-F, or MDG-S.
  • Experience with SAP S/4HANA integration and other SAAS and non-SAP systems.
  • Solid understanding of data governance frameworks and master data lifecycle
  • Experience configuring: Data Models & Change Request Types, BRF+ Rules, Workflow, Data Replication Framework (DRF)
  • Knowledge of Fiori apps and MDG UI customization
  • Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including data analysts, IT, and business stakeholders, to ensure seamless integration and alignment of MDG solutions.
  • Training and Support: Provide training and support to team members and end-users on MDG best practices and solutions.
  • Provide regular reports on system health and performance.
  • Knowledge of agile methodologies and frameworks such as Kanban as well as use of tools like Jira and Service Now.
  • Facilitate work and resource estimation, track progress, provide escalations and status updates.


Preferred Skills



  • SAP MDG Certification

title: Coordenador de Banco de Dados
description:
Quais são os desafios da área e do cargo:

Esta pessoa terá como objetivo atuar de forma alinhada à visão estratégica de Negócios do Grupo Fleury, contribuindo para a construção de um ecossistema de Saúde integrado, preventivo e híbrido, tendo como principal foco o cuidado com as pessoas.

Se você tem interesse em fazer parte desse propósito e deseja estar sempre um passo a frente do mercado, vem com a gente!


Sobre a área:

  • Lidar com diversos fornecedores de produtos e serviços que atendem a disciplina de Banco de Dados acompanhando, gerindo e cobrando ações quando necessário.
  • Interagir com as áreas pares para entender e endereçar demandas, novos projetos, problemas, duvidas e reclamações a respeito do ambiente de Bando de Dados.
  • Cuidar para que o ambiente se mantenha atualizado e com as ultimas features de segurança.
  • Assegurar o uso otimizado dos recursos tecnológicos da plataforma através da análise das métricas de capacidade dos bancos de dados;
  • Planejar, elaborar e executar projetos de infraestrutura de Banco de Dados liderando equipes heterogêneas afim de otimizar e maximizar a performance de cada indivíduo além de atender as novas demandas das áreas de negócio;
  • Implantar recursos de bancos de dados para capacitar o ambiente a suportar crescimentos e demandas de negócio mesmo que ainda não mapeadas;
  • Apoiar, instruir e direcionar o time técnico afim de sanar dúvidas, questões técnicas ou processuais a respeito da disciplina de Banco de Dados;
  • Cumprir as metas estabelecidas no Contrato de Gestão e vigente, através da execução das ações previstas no plano de metas;


Principais atividades:

  • Supervisionar e acompanhar a disciplina de Banco de Dados, participando de projetos e crises, contribuindo e orientando os seus liderados na forma de atuar e ser um facilitador nas interfaces com as outras disciplinas tanto de Operações, Engenharia de Infraestrutura e Engenharia de Desenvolvimento.
  • Acompanhar, validar e medir a qualidade e saúde do ambiente de Banco de Dados.
  • Estruturar e acompanhar os indicadores da area de Banco de Dados .
  • Tracionar iniciativas de automação para a gestão do ambiente de Banco de Dados, reduzindo atividades operacionais e garantindo agilidade e tempo de resposta as mudanças de ambiente.
  • Contribuir para obter um clima organizacional favorável, bem como a redução do turn over, através de ferramentas de gestão de pessoas, como contratações assertivas, comunicação interna eficaz, treinamento e desenvolvimento, reconhecimento e recompensa, buscando equipes de alta performance.
  • Zelar pelo sigilo das informações tratadas na sua área de atuação.
  • Cumprir as metas estabelecidas no Contrato de Gestão vigente, através da execução das ações previstas no plano de metas. Liderar um time de Banco de Dados com diversas stacks de Banco de Dados tanto onpremises quanto em Cloud.



Buscamos alguém que apresente:

  • Experiencia em gestão de pessoas
  • Habilidade de construir matriz de decisão, RFPs e RFIs
  • Experiencia de gestão financeira e de contratos de infraestrutura de TI
  • Conhecimento Avançado de banco de dados SQL Server
  • Conhecimento de Bancos Nativos Cloud
  • Conhecimento de banco de dados My SQL (Desejável)
  • Conhecimento de banco de dados No SQL (Desejável)
  • Cursos e certificações correlatas a Banco de dados


Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito.


Nossa essência inspira o dia a dia, por isso, buscamos pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem, e que:


• Estimulem um ambiente de troca de conhecimentos, compartilhando experiências, possibilitando a interdependência entre os times;

• Estejam em constante movimento, investindo em autodesenvolvimento e atuando como facilitadora no desenvolvimento das outras pessoas;

• Busquem consciência social de diversidade e inclusão, cooperando com a construção de um ambiente colaborativo;

• Identifiquem e antecipem as necessidades dos clientes, agindo prontamente para encontrar soluções adequadas e personalizadas;

• Planejem e executem o trabalho com excelência a fim de atingir os resultados esperados, com a visão de inovação e agilidade;

• Gerem e implementem novas ideias, buscando constantemente por melhorias para a experimentação de novas abordagens e a adaptação às mudanças do mercado.


Informações da vaga:

Modelo de Trabalho (Home Office)

Carga Horária: 220h

Escala: Segunda a Sexta

Horário de Trabalho: 08h00 ás 17h48


Cuidamos de você em cada etapa da sua jornada!


Saúde e Bem-estar:

• Assistência médica e odontológica para você e sua família;

• Ambulatório com clínica médica ou atendimento por telemedicina;

• Linhas de cuidado especializadas: gestantes, adoção, obesidade, oncologia, entre outras;

• Acesso à plataforma OrienteMe para sessões de terapia e orientação nutricional;

• Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas;

• Acesso ao Wellhub para práticas esportivas e qualidade de vida.


Proteção e estabilidade:

• Previdência privada;

• Participação nos lucros;

• Seguro de vida.


Facilidades para o dia a dia:

• Vale-Alimentação;

• Vale-Refeição;

• Vale-Transporte;

• Auxílio-Creche;

• Clube de Descontos com lojas, farmácias, viagem, beleza, cultura, lazer, entre outros serviços.


Desenvolvimento e educação:

• Plataforma de ensino;

• Parcerias educacionais com descontos em cursos e instituições.


Aqui, o cuidado vai além dos benefícios — ele está presente em cada momento da sua trajetória.


Promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, focada na equidade e na valorização das diferenças. Nossas vagas são abertas para todos os públicos e, simbolizando a nossa intencionalidade, oferecemos oportunidades afirmativas.


Nosso compromisso vai além do cumprimento das legislações que incentivam a diversidade e inclusão. Trabalhamos ativamente para ampliar a representatividade de nossas pessoas, pensando em raça, etnia, gênero, gerações, pessoas com deficiência e LGBTQIAPN+ em nosso time, além de fortalecer a representatividade de mulheres negras, indígenas, chefes de família.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Exciting New Career Opportunity: Software Engineer - Quality & AI Infrastructure

Company: Hirebus

Location: Remote in Brazil

Pay: $30K-$60K per year


We're hiring a mid-level engineer to own two things: the quality of our codebase and the early foundations of our AI agent work.


The role

Most of your time will be spent making our existing software more reliable. You'll dig into production bugs, trace them to root cause, and write the tests that should have caught them. You'll review pull requests in a way that raises the bar without demoralizing anyone. You'll tackle the tech debt that everyone complains about in retros but nobody picks up.


The other part — and this is growing — is our AI agent work. We're building tooling, orchestration, and evaluation systems for LLM-powered features. This isn't a research project. It's production software that needs the same rigor as everything else we ship. We need someone who can bring that rigor.


What you'll do

  • Debug and fix issues across the stack, from staging through production
  • Build meaningful test coverage (the kind that actually catches regressions)
  • Review code thoroughly — with context, not just style nits
  • Refactor the parts of the codebase that slow the team down
  • Help define how we ship: observability, release process, quality gates
  • Work with product and design to land features cleanly
  • Contribute to our AI agent infrastructure: tool-calling, orchestration, evaluation, safety


Technical Requirements

  • 7+ years of professional engineering experience with a track record of shipping production SaaS products
  • Expert in Node.js, React, and TypeScript with strong product architecture instincts (scalability, maintainability, speed of iteration)
  • Hands-on Supabase experience: Postgres schema design, RLS policies, edge functions, and auth
  • Shipped production LLM-powered features (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) with a working understanding of prompt engineering, evals, latency/cost tradeoffs, and guardrails
  • Experience building agentic workflows, RAG systems, or tool-use integrations (MCP, function calling)
  • Excellent written English and self-directed async work style, with meaningful overlap with US Mountain Time
  • Comfortable using AI-native development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) as part of daily workflow


Your first 90 days:

  • Month 1: You've shipped real bug fixes. You're in the PR review rotation and contributing useful feedback. You have context on the parts of the system that break most often.
  • Month 2: Test coverage in your area has improved measurably. You've identified at least one chunk of tech debt worth prioritizing and started on it.
  • Month 3: You've shipped a meaningful refactor. You've made your first contributions to the AI agent infrastructure — something concrete, with results we can point to.


We're not looking for someone who wants to rewrite everything from scratch. We want someone who makes the team steadily better — through reliable fixes, honest reviews, and the kind of infrastructure work that compounds over time. If you're also curious about what engineering looks like as AI agents become part of the workflow, even better.

title: Senior Business Analyst (Healthcare Marketing)
description:
One of our clients, a USA Healthcare Commercialization firm, is looking for a Senior Business Analyst with experience in SOWs and Project Finance. This role would be focused on their Speaker Bureau operations (organization of medical conferences and congresses).


The Sr. Business Analyst is responsible for managing financial and operational aspects of assigned clients and their products. This role requires a high level of understanding of the assigned clients and products, various speaker bureau project types, and the ability to work independently.


The Sr. Business Analyst works closely with the Director and financial analysts to ensure accurate internal and external financial reporting, develop budget proposals and provide financial related support in client meetings.


Financial


● Oversee day-to-day financial operations for speaker bureau, including budget tracking, internal revenue accruals, forecasting and variance analysis.

● Develops Statement of Work (SOW), ensuring final sign-off by Director as required.

● Create and manage budgets and proposals, providing oversight for complex SOWs. Prepare speaker bureau specific budgets, accrual reports and monthly financial management updates

● Work closely with program directors on monthly accrual reports, reviewing and discussing as needed.

● Ensure accuracy in financial reconciliation data before releasing reports to clients

● Generate and distribute monthly accruals and budget reports for clients

● Provide invoicing amounts to Accounts Receivable to facilitate timely invoice submissions


Operational


● Ensures compliance with internal Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and client specific SOPs.

● Provides budget related support in client meetings as needed.

● Participates in accrual meetings with clients based on their SOPs.

● Contributes to process improvement initiatives to enhance financial operations.


Experience and Skills


● 2+ Years experience in budgeting · Proficiency in Excel functions for financial modeling and analysis.

● Strong financial analysis skills, including budget tracking, forecasting and variance analysis · Excellent understanding of internal SOPs and ability to ensure compliance

● Familiar with all internal and external SOPs.

● Strives to find process efficiencies by thinking outside the box and making recommendations for change.

● Knowledge of ERP systems, NetSuite a plus

● Excellent client facing skills, including comfortability with all types of client communications.

● Prior speaker bureau experience a plus

title: Junior Data Analyst - Remote, Brazil (New Graduates Welcome) Wowoo · Full-time · 100% Remote
description:

Our portfolio includes ChatPrime, AI Baby Generator, and FaceForm. As part of our expansion in Latin America, we're opening entry-level positions for talented new graduates and early-career professionals in Brazil.

We pay in USD, work fully remote, and invest heavily in the growth of our junior team members.

What We Offer

  • Competitive USD compensation, well above local market for entry-level roles
  • 100% remote, work from anywhere in Brazil
  • Direct mentorship from senior analysts and founders
  • Real ownership and visibility from day one - no coffee runs, no busywork

K-Books is a U.S.-based accounting firm that provides financial consulting services to small businesses, ensuring clients have the clarity and insights needed to make informed business decisions.


We offer a wide range of services, from basic bookkeeping and financial reviews to training clients on best practices for bookkeeping processes and procedures. Our services also include analysis and optimization of insurance plans, retirement plans, and employee benefits, as well as budgeting, financial projections, tax strategy, and overall financial planning.


Role Description

We are seeking a dedicated Junior to Intermediate Bookkeeper for a full-time remote position. Key responsibilities include:


  • Maintaining accurate financial records
  • Transaction categorization and data accuracy
  • Bank and credit card reconciliations
  • Supporting the month-end close process


Requirements

  • Fluent English (written and spoken)
  • Based in Brazil
  • Previous experience living, studying, or working abroad
  • Experience in financial routines (AP/AR, transaction categorization, reconciliations, month-end)
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field is preferred


Profile We’re Looking For

  • Proactive and self-driven
  • Fast learner and problem-solver
  • Comfortable working in an international environment
  • Strong sense of responsibility and ownership


What we offer

  • Competitive compensation based on experience (contractor – PJ/MEI)
  • Annual performance-based bonus
  • Career growth opportunities
  • Potential travel allowance for international trips (once per year)
  • Exposure to international clients and work environment


100% Remote | Brazil-based only

Interested? Apply via LinkedIn.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Exciting New Career Opportunity: Software Engineer - Quality & AI Infrastructure

Company: Hirebus

Location: Remote in Brazil

Pay: $30K-$60K per year


We're hiring a mid-level engineer to own two things: the quality of our codebase and the early foundations of our AI agent work.


The role

Most of your time will be spent making our existing software more reliable. You'll dig into production bugs, trace them to root cause, and write the tests that should have caught them. You'll review pull requests in a way that raises the bar without demoralizing anyone. You'll tackle the tech debt that everyone complains about in retros but nobody picks up.


The other part — and this is growing — is our AI agent work. We're building tooling, orchestration, and evaluation systems for LLM-powered features. This isn't a research project. It's production software that needs the same rigor as everything else we ship. We need someone who can bring that rigor.


What you'll do

  • Debug and fix issues across the stack, from staging through production
  • Build meaningful test coverage (the kind that actually catches regressions)
  • Review code thoroughly — with context, not just style nits
  • Refactor the parts of the codebase that slow the team down
  • Help define how we ship: observability, release process, quality gates
  • Work with product and design to land features cleanly
  • Contribute to our AI agent infrastructure: tool-calling, orchestration, evaluation, safety


Technical Requirements

  • 7+ years of professional engineering experience with a track record of shipping production SaaS products
  • Expert in Node.js, React, and TypeScript with strong product architecture instincts (scalability, maintainability, speed of iteration)
  • Hands-on Supabase experience: Postgres schema design, RLS policies, edge functions, and auth
  • Shipped production LLM-powered features (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) with a working understanding of prompt engineering, evals, latency/cost tradeoffs, and guardrails
  • Experience building agentic workflows, RAG systems, or tool-use integrations (MCP, function calling)
  • Excellent written English and self-directed async work style, with meaningful overlap with US Mountain Time
  • Comfortable using AI-native development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) as part of daily workflow


Your first 90 days:

  • Month 1: You've shipped real bug fixes. You're in the PR review rotation and contributing useful feedback. You have context on the parts of the system that break most often.
  • Month 2: Test coverage in your area has improved measurably. You've identified at least one chunk of tech debt worth prioritizing and started on it.
  • Month 3: You've shipped a meaningful refactor. You've made your first contributions to the AI agent infrastructure — something concrete, with results we can point to.


We're not looking for someone who wants to rewrite everything from scratch. We want someone who makes the team steadily better — through reliable fixes, honest reviews, and the kind of infrastructure work that compounds over time. If you're also curious about what engineering looks like as AI agents become part of the workflow, even better.

title: Junior Data Analyst - Remote, Brazil (New Graduates Welcome) Wowoo · Full-time · 100% Remote
description:
About Wowoo Wowoo is a global consumer technology company building AI-powered mobile applications used by millions of people around the world. Our portfolio includes ChatPrime, AI Baby Generator, and FaceForm. As part of our expansion in Latin America, we're opening entry-level positions for talented new graduates and early-career professionals in Brazil.

We pay in USD, work fully remote, and invest heavily in the growth of our junior team members.

The Role We're hiring a Junior Data Analyst to join our growth and product analytics team. This is an entry-level role designed for recent graduates or early-career analysts who want to learn from a senior global team and work on real, high-impact business problems from day one.

You'll help us understand how millions of users discover, subscribe to, and engage with our products, and your analysis will directly influence product and marketing decisions.

What You'll Do

  • Build dashboards and reports in BigQuery, Looker, and Metabase to track product, marketing, and revenue metrics
  • Analyze user behavior, subscription funnels, and marketing campaign performance
  • Partner with product managers, marketers, and engineers to answer business questions with data
  • Document findings clearly and present insights to a global team
  • Learn modern data stack tools and grow into a senior analyst over time

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree (completed or in final year) in a quantitative or analytical field: Statistics, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science, Business Analytics, Mathematics, or similar
  • Solid SQL fundamentals (we'll test this) or strong willingness to master SQL within the first weeks
  • Comfort with spreadsheets and basic data manipulation
  • Strong written English; comfortable communicating findings clearly in writing
  • Curious, analytical mindset and attention to detail
  • Self-motivated and comfortable working independently in a remote environment

Nice to Have

  • Internship experience in data, analytics, business intelligence, or consulting
  • Familiarity with Python, R, BigQuery, Looker, Tableau, or Metabase
  • Coursework or projects in statistics, A/B testing, or experimentation
  • Interest in consumer apps, subscription business models, or growth marketing

What We Offer

  • Competitive USD compensation, well above local market for entry-level roles
  • 100% remote, work from anywhere in Brazil
  • Direct mentorship from senior analysts and founders
  • Real ownership and visibility from day one - no coffee runs, no busywork
  • Flexible hours and async-first culture
  • Clear growth path to Mid-level Analyst within 18-24 months
  • Learning budget for courses, books, and conferences

Who Should Apply If you just graduated or are graduating soon, this is for you. If you've been doing internships and want your first full-time role at an international company, this is for you. If you're switching careers from a non-technical background but have strong analytical skills and SQL chops, we want to hear from you.

We don't care which university you attended. We care about how you think.

  • Wowoo is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (TypeScript + React)
description:
Role Overview: Own full-stack product end-to-end. Lead Product engineering role with strong ownership, full direct communication with the client and AI workflows.

Experience Level: 7+ years

Location: Remote

Tech Stack: TypeScript + React, Prisma, Fastify, Mantine

Contract Type: Full-time, B2B contract


About the Role

Radity  is a global software engineering company delivering innovative digital solutions to clients around the world. We are passionate about building great technology and fostering a collaborative environment where people grow, take ownership, and make a real impact.


Our client is a US insurance company, subsidiary of Fortune 500 companies. This is an “insurance startup” with an agile culture and approach to work, and future oriented approach to technology. Product is internally developed Claims Management system. The product is in the early development stage. Once MVP goes live, project will continue to stabilize the product and enhance it with new features and AI -powered workflows embedded directly into real business processes.


Radity is running software development projects with the client for more than 3 years. This is not an outsourcing role, but a real product engineering role, where you will be part of a big joint Radity and Client team. Engineers are trusted with context, real problems, and responsibility for delivering outcomes.


You’ll work closely with product managers, designers, and sometimes clients to design, build, and evolve a complex platform used by insurance professionals every day.


What You’ll Do

  • Own features end to end — from understanding the business problem to solution design, implementation, deployment, and iteration
  • Design and build backend services using TypeScript, Prisma and Fastify
  • Develop modern frontend features using React and TypeScript
  • Work with PostgreSQL
  • Contribute to the evolution of the platform architecture and technical standards
  • Build and integrate AI-powered workflows that support complex claims management business flows, using existing AI services and tooling where appropriate
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and stakeholders to shape solutions, not just implement requirements
  • Take responsibility for testing, CI/CD, releases, and production readiness
  • Continuously improve performance, reliability, observability, and developer experience
  • Use modern AI-assisted coding tools as part of daily engineering work


What We’re Looking For

  • 7+ years of professional experience as a software engineer
  • Strong hands-on experience with TypeScript + React, Prisma
  • Experience building and operating real production systems (not just isolated components)
  • Solid understanding of system design, architecture, and trade-offs
  • Comfort working with incomplete requirements and asking the right questions
  • Experience with Azure or similar cloud platforms
  • Practical experience with CI/CD, automated testing, and deployments
  • Product-oriented mindset — focus on user value and business outcomes
  • Active, practical use of AI tools in daily development
  • Experience in client-facing or stakeholder discussions
  • Upper-Intermediate English or higher


Nice to have (not required)

  • Insurtech background


Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive market-level compensation based on experience and location
  • Generous vacation policy
  • Full equipment provided
  • Paid access to modern AI tools, learning resources, and subscriptions
  • Support for continuous learning and professional development
  • Strong engineering culture with high trust and autonomy


Why This Role

  • High ownership and real influence on product direction
  • Engineers are trusted to think, design, and decide, not just execute
  • Direct Exposure to the top engineering team
  • AI is a real working tool and part of the product, not a buzzword
  • Long-term product vision with solid business fundamentals


Recruitment process

  • Recruiter Screen: short intro call to align on experience, mindset, location, and compensation
  • Hiring Manager Interview: product- and case-focused discussion with an Engineering Manager (no take-home task)
  • Interview with the Client’s CTO
  • Offer

title: \"Salesforce Analyst #997821\"
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Nosso Cliente

Esta vaga irá atender uma das maiores empresas globais do setor de energia, com forte atuação em inovação, tecnologia e transformação digital. O profissional atuará em iniciativas estratégicas voltadas para marketing digital, automação e experiência do cliente , em um ambiente global e colaborativo.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Ser referência técnica de Salesforce dentro das equipes.
  • Desenvolver e integrar soluções em Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Pardot (Account Engagement), Commerce Cloud e Experience Cloud .
  • Apoiar metodologias ágeis (Scrum, SAFe ) na execução dos projetos.
  • Criar e consumir APIs para integração com Salesforce e Azure .
  • Gerenciar versionamento de código com GitHub e pipelines de CI/CD (GitHub Actions ).
  • Produzir documentação técnica clara.
  • Coletar requisitos com stakeholders e validar entregáveis.


O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência com Salesforce Marketing Cloud
  • Vivência com Journey Builder e Automation Studio
  • Conhecimento em SQL e AMPscript
  • Experiência com integrações via API
  • Inglês avançado/fluente (mandatório)
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum ou Kanban)

Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Experiência com Sales Cloud ou Commerce Cloud
  • Conhecimento em Pardot (Account Engagement) ou Experience Cloud
  • Noções de Git/GitHub ou CI/CD
  • Conhecimento em HTML, CSS ou JavaScript para personalização de campanhas
  • Perfil proativo, com boa comunicação e autonomia


Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

title: Especialista de Implantação SAP PY
description:
Na ADP, somos movidos pelo seu sucesso. Envolvemos seus talentos e perspectivas únicos. Acolhemos suas ideias para fazer as coisas de modo diferente e melhor. Nós apoiamos seus esforços para realizar, aprender e crescer. Se o sucesso te motiva, você pertence à ADP.

Nos esforçamos para que cada interação seja motivada pelos nossos valores CENTRAIS: Conhecimento e Visão, Integridade é Tudo, Excelência na Prestação de Serviços, Inovação Inspiradora, Cada Pessoa Conta, Orientação a Resultados e Responsabilidade Social.

Nossa cultura acolhe diversas perspectivas e cria um lugar onde as carreiras podem florescer. Nós respeitamos e valorizamos as diferenças com oportunidades iguais de emprego, independentemente de raça, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, idade, cultura, deficiência ou status social.

Todas as nossas vagas respeitam esse compromisso. Faça parte do nosso time!

RESUMO DA POSIÇÃO


Como Consultor SAP, você atuará como facilitador entre a equipe de implementação e os clientes para entender melhor suas necessidades de negócios.

Atuará também como mentor ou treinador de parceiros. Preparará especificações funcionais, incluindo detalhes sobre design e configuração.

FUNÇÕES:


  • Resolver os problemas reportados nos SLAs.
  • Configuração do SAP HCM PY para folha de pagamento Brasil, Argentina, Colombia e Costa Rica
  • Fornecer aos clientes o status das implementações
  • Guarde a documentação do cliente
  • Fornecer suporte a aplicativos
  • Reunir-se com clientes sempre que necessário
  • Aplicar conhecimento funcional relevante específico do país para potencializar o serviço focado no cliente
  • Realizar testes unitários
  • Fornecer documentação

REQUISITOS:

  • Experiência em implementação SAP HCM, módulo de folha de pagamento (PY)
  • Ensino superior completo
  • Inglês em nível avançado para conversação


O modelo de trabalho adotado pela ADP é office based/presencial, com a possibilidade de trabalho em home-office por até duas vezes na semana

Considerando que as atividades desempenhadas pelos ocupantes deste cargo envolvem acesso a informações altamente confidenciais e sensíveis de clientes da ADP e de seus respectivos empregados, a ADP reserva-se o direito de conduzir checagem de histórico, de tempos em tempos, conforme autoriza o Incidente de Recurso de Revista Repetitivo nº 01 do Tribunal Superior do Trabalho, mediante consentimento do candidato/trabalhador.”

title: Innovations & Practice Manager
description:
Líder mundial em Recursos Humanos, a Adecco está presente em 60 países, por meio de uma rede de 5.500 delegações que diariamente proporcionam emprego a 700.000 pessoas e prestam serviços a mais de 100.000 empresas. Faz parte da Fortune Global 500 e está cotada na bolsa de Zurique. A Adecco possui uma estrutura global orientada para a oferta de soluções integradas em Recursos Humanos, com o compromisso de desenvolver continuamente serviços eficazes e competitivos para seus clientes.

Assessoramos importante empresa internacional de BPO.

O Innovations & Practice Manager será responsável por liderar a evolução do portfólio de serviços da empresa, transformando operações tradicionais em soluções digitais inovadoras , alavancadas por Inteligência Artificial, Dados e Automação .

Este profissional atuará como um agente de transformação , conectando tecnologia, negócio e clientes, com impacto direto em crescimento, posicionamento de mercado e geração de receita.


Principais Responsabilidades


Transformação do Modelo de Negócio

  • Liderar a evolução de serviços standard para soluções digitais e escaláveis
  • Identificar oportunidades de inovação e melhoria nos modelos atuais


Desenho e Evolução do Portfólio de Serviços

  • Criar, estruturar e lançar um portfólio de soluções baseado em:
  • Inteligência Artificial (IA / GenAI)
  • Analytics avançado
  • Automação e RPA
  • Tecnologias emergentes
  • Garantir alinhamento com tendências de mercado e necessidades dos clientes


Roadmap de Inovação

  • Definir e executar o roadmap de inovação de médio e longo prazo
  • Priorizar iniciativas com base em impacto, viabilidade e retorno sobre investimento


Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento (R&D)

  • Monitorar tendências tecnológicas e de mercado
  • Avaliar e selecionar ferramentas, plataformas e parceiros estratégicos


Pré-vendas e Suporte Comercial

  • Atuar diretamente em processos de pré-vendas
  • Traduzir necessidades dos clientes em propostas de valor tecnológicas
  • Contribuir para o fechamento de contratos estratégicos


Construção de Capacidades Internas

  • Definir a estratégia para criação de um time interno de tecnologia
  • Liderar, no médio prazo, equipes de:
  • Desenvolvimento
  • Dados
  • Inteligência Artificial
  • Definir padrões, metodologias e melhores práticas


Implementação e Execução

  • Acompanhar projetos de transformação digital junto aos clientes
  • Garantir a implementação eficaz das soluções definidas


Gestão de Tecnologia

  • Selecionar e implementar ferramentas tecnológicas chave
  • Garantir escalabilidade, eficiência e adoção das soluções


Requisitos


Experiência Profissional

  • Mínimo de 7 anos de experiência em tecnologia, inovação ou transformação digital
  • Experiência comprovada em:
  • Implementação de soluções baseadas em IA, dados ou automação
  • Pré-venda técnica em ambientes de tecnologia, BPO ou consultoria
  • Arquitetura de dados
  • Liderança de times técnicos
  • Atuação direta em geração de receita e fechamento de negócios


Conhecimentos Técnicos

  • Inteligência Artificial (Machine Learning, GenAI)
  • Arquitetura de dados e plataformas em nuvem
  • Automação de processos (RPA, workflows)
  • Metodologias ágeis


Exemplos de tecnologias:

  • Cloud: AWS, Azure, GCP
  • Dados: SQL, Python, ferramentas de BI
  • IA: Plataformas e frameworks de inteligência artificial
  • Gestão: Jira, ferramentas ágeis

title: AI Reasoning Engineer (Mathematics & Python)
description:
Company Description

MillionLogics, a trusted Oracle Partner, is a global IT solutions provider with offices in London, UK, and a development hub in Hyderabad, India. The company specializes in delivering smart, scalable, and future-ready IT solutions to empower businesses to evolve and lead. With expertise in Data & AI, Cloud migrations, IT consulting, and enterprise application optimization, MillionLogics offers tailored services with a focus on client success. Supported by a team of over 50 AI & Oracle experts, MillionLogics combines cutting-edge technology with a commitment to delivering impactful outcomes. Learn more about our services on our website.


Role Description

We are seeking a highly analytical and computationally proficient individual to join our team with a strong research background. You will be instrumental in contributing to this role by either crafting challenging and insightful problems in your respective research domain, devising elegant computational solutions.


Offer Details:

  • Pay: $1500 per month (Net/take-home)
  • Mode of work - Fully Remote


Responsibilities:

  • Build multi-agent benchmark tasks that require multi-step mathematical reasoning, proof construction, or algorithmic problem-solving
  • Design problems that are genuinely hard for a single agent but decomposable — competition math, numerical analysis, combinatorial optimization, statistical inference
  • Create verification scripts that check mathematical correctness — numerical answers with appropriate tolerance, proof step validity, algorithm output correctness
  • Write clear problem statements with precise notation, definitions, and output format
  • Create decomposition guides that split problems into independent sub-computations or parallel solution strategies


Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years in mathematics, quantitative research, or computational science — competition math, university-level mathematics, or quantitative research background Python programming — NumPy, SciPy, or symbolic computation (SymPy) Experience writing mathematical proofs or formal derivations.
  • Ability to create problems with precise, verifiable answers — not subjective or open-ended.
  • Experience with AI coding benchmarks (SWE-bench, Terminal-bench) Comfortable with Docker — writing Dockerfiles, building images, and debugging container issues.
  • Understanding of numerical methods — floating point tolerance, convergence criteria, error bounds.


Strong plus:  

  • Experience creating math competition problems (AMC, AIME, Putnam, IMO, or similar). 
  • Research in mathematics, theoretical CS, or quantitative fields. 
  • Experience with automated theorem proving or formal verification. 
  • Knowledge of AI reasoning benchmarks (GSM8K, MATH, AIME, GPQA, ARC-AGI). 
  • Experience with large-scale numerical computation or scientific computing


Example of what you will produce:

A task requiring analysis of a system of 50 coupled differential equations modeling a chemical reaction network. The agent must determine equilibrium concentrations, stability conditions, and bifurcation points. Input includes the reaction network as a matrix, rate constants, and initial conditions. The verifier checks numerical answers with tolerance (1e-6), validates eigenvalue analysis for stability, and confirms bifurcation parameter ranges. The decomposition splits into 4 sub-agents: one computes equilibria, one analyzes local stability, one maps bifurcations, and one synthesizes the phase portrait. Oracle scores 1.0, single-agent scores 0.25, multi-agent scores 0.80.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: 8 hours per day with a 4-hour overlap with PST.
  • Employment Type: Contractor position (Note: this role does not include medical/paid leave).
  • Duration of Contract: 6months (expected start date is next week).


How to Apply?

Please send us your updated CV to with job ID 75046 in the email subject line.

title: BDR (Business Development Representative)
description:
About Foundey

Foundey is a strategic UI/UX design agency specializing in supporting SaaS, AI, and tech startups. Our mission is to help startups create user experiences that match their potential through design that connects user behavior to business success. We partner closely with founders to deliver high-impact design solutions—from MVP design sprints to full-scale product interface design and UX audits.


The Opportunity

We’re looking for a proactive, hands on and results-driven Business Development Representative (BDR) to help expand Foundey’s pipeline of high-quality startup clients. In this role, you’ll be responsible for identifying, engaging, and qualifying potential customers—primarily founders and decision-makers in SaaS, AI, and tech companies.

You’ll play a critical role in connecting innovative startups with design solutions that drive real business outcomes. This is a great opportunity for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments and enjoys building relationships from the ground up.


Key Responsibilities

  • Identify and research potential clients within SaaS, AI, and tech startup ecosystems
  • Conduct outbound prospecting via email, LinkedIn, and other channels
  • Qualify inbound and outbound leads to assess fit and readiness
  • Schedule and coordinate discovery calls for the sales or leadership team
  • Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of opportunities
  • Collaborate with marketing and design teams to refine outreach messaging
  • Track activities and performance using CRM tools
  • Continuously optimize outreach strategies based on results and feedback


Qualifications

  • 3 years+ of experience in sales, business development, or lead generation (preferably in SaaS or agency environments)
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, especially in written outreach
  • Experience with outbound prospecting and cold outreach
  • Familiarity with CRM tools (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce)
  • Ability to understand and communicate design, product, or tech-related concepts
  • Self-motivated, organized, and comfortable working remotely
  • English proficiency required (additional languages are a plus)


Nice to Have

  • Experience selling design, product, or digital services
  • Understanding of UI/UX design processes and product development
  • Experience working with early-stage startups or founders


Why Join Us?

At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

title: Solution Consultant
description:
Employment Type: Full-time position employed by a partner agency (3rd party, B2B)


About Sisense

Sisense is a leading AI-powered Analytics Platform as a Service (AnPaaS) that empowers product teams and developers to embed conversational, predictive, and agentic intelligence directly into applications and workflows. Our API-first, developer-first platform turns complex data into faster, smarter, actionable decisions for over 2,000 global customers across financial services, retail, healthcare, and technology.

With the recent launch of Sisense Intelligence, including the Intelligence Assistant (natural-language analytics creation), Model Context Protocol (MCP) server (secure external LLM integration), and Managed LLM capabilities, we're accelerating innovation in embedded analytics, enabling governed, scalable AI experiences at enterprise scale.


The Role

As a Solution Consultant on our Field Engineering team, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor to strategic customers, guiding them through complex analytics and data initiatives to achieve measurable business outcomes. You will lead technical discovery, design best-practice solution architectures, and partner closely with customers and internal teams to ensure successful, scalable deployments across cloud-native and embedded environments.


Why Join Our Field Engineering Services Team

You’ll operate at the intersection of customer success, product innovation, and business impact. This role gives you direct influence over high-value implementations, the opportunity to shape product direction through customer insights, and the chance to work on cutting-edge AI-embedded analytics projects with global enterprises. You’ll collaborate with diverse teams while driving real value for customers and contributing to Sisense’s growth.


Responsibilities

  • Partner directly with customers to accelerate analytics initiatives, recommend scalable architectures, and align technical solutions with long-term business goals.
  • Lead deep technical discovery sessions to understand customer data maturity, use cases, and operational constraints.
  • Own the technical customer relationship as a trusted advisor, guiding solution design across cloud-native, embedded, and secure analytics environments.
  • Design, review, and optimize data models, queries, and analytical workflows to support performant, scalable solutions.
  • Deliver onboarding sessions, solution walkthroughs, and enablement workshops tailored to customers with intermediate to advanced data and analytics maturity.
  • Create and deliver customized technical presentations and demonstrations for audiences ranging from hands-on practitioners to executive stakeholders.
  • Provide guidance on authentication, security, and access control concepts, including SSO patterns and user-level data access strategies.
  • Consult on embedding analytics into applications, including session handling and integration best practices.
  • Support solution reviews, migrations, upgrades, and architectural optimizations across customer environments.
  • Assist customers with platform administration and configuration tasks, including API automation and environment setup.
  • Collaborate closely with internal engineering, product, and support teams to surface customer feedback, identify issues, and influence future enhancements.
  • Capture and share best practices, reference architectures, and technical assets to scale knowledge across customers and internal teams.
  • Evangelize Sisense best practices through workshops, community engagement, and technical thought leadership.


About You

  • 3-5+ years of experience in a technical, customer-facing role (e.g., Solution Consultant, Pre-Sales Engineer, Technical Consultant, Implementation Specialist, or similar).
  • Hands-on experience with modern BI and analytics platforms (Sisense preferred; Tableau, Looker, Power BI, or similar acceptable).
  • Proven success leading or contributing to complex BI, cloud, or data platform implementations, from discovery through delivery.
  • Strong data modeling expertise within a BI context, including dimensional modeling and working with large, complex datasets.
  • SQL proficiency: understands join types, normalization - has the ability to join data across disparate sources, optimize queries, and design efficient analytical models.
  • Experience designing and delivering customized technical presentations and product demonstrations for audiences ranging from hands-on practitioners to executive stakeholders.
  • Ability to translate technical concepts into clear business value, adapting communication style to technical and non-technical audiences alike.
  • Solid technical foundation, including experience with:
  • JavaScript, HTML/CSS (nice to have; strong preference for hands-on exposure)
  • REST APIs and platform integrations
  • Linux-based environments and containerized architectures (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Experience providing guidance on authentication and security, including implementing or supporting SSO solutions (SAML 2.0, OIDC, JWT).
  • Detailed understanding of analytics embedding, including hands-on implementation using iFrames and related integration patterns.
  • Working knowledge of ETL methodologies, data pipelines, and upstream data preparation concepts.
  • Nice to have: prior experience with technical project management or leading workstreams across cross-functional teams.


What We Offer

  • Employment through a partner agency (B2B).
  • Competitive base salary up to USD 4300 per month (depending on experience).
  • Opportunity to work with a global leader in AI-powered embedded analytics.
  • Flexible remote work with a collaborative international team.
  • Professional development and growth opportunities.

description:

Nosso propósito é oferecer tratamentos personalizados, modernos e humanizados, sempre priorizando a saúde, o bem-estar e a satisfação de nossos pacientes. Valorizamos um ambiente acolhedor, organizado e profissional, onde cada pessoa se sinta bem recebida desde o primeiro contato.

Assegurar a escrituração e entregas dos impostos e obrigações acessórias, visando a

title: Reconciliation Systems Architect (IntelliMatch DIM)
description:
About the Role

We are looking for an experienced IntelliMatch (DIM) Solution Architect to lead the design, development, and evolution of our reconciliation platform. This role combines architectural ownership with hands-on technical expertise , playing a key role in delivering scalable and efficient reconciliation solutions across global banking systems.

You will act as a technical authority , guiding development, support, and functional teams while ensuring best practices, performance, and architectural integrity.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and own end-to-end architecture for IntelliMatch (DIM) solutions
  • Lead hands-on development , including configurations, enhancements, and automation
  • Design and implement SQL-based reconciliation logic and workflows
  • Establish and enforce technical standards and best practices
  • Drive integration strategies between IntelliMatch and upstream/downstream systems
  • Act as technical lead during delivery , ensuring quality across implementation, testing, and release
  • Collaborate with stakeholders on backlog prioritization and solution planning
  • Analyze existing systems to identify performance and architectural improvements
  • Maintain detailed architecture documentation and design artifacts

title: AI Reasoning Engineer (Mathematics & Python)
description:
Company Description

MillionLogics, a trusted Oracle Partner, is a global IT solutions provider with offices in London, UK, and a development hub in Hyderabad, India. The company specializes in delivering smart, scalable, and future-ready IT solutions to empower businesses to evolve and lead. With expertise in Data & AI, Cloud migrations, IT consulting, and enterprise application optimization, MillionLogics offers tailored services with a focus on client success. Supported by a team of over 50 AI & Oracle experts, MillionLogics combines cutting-edge technology with a commitment to delivering impactful outcomes. Learn more about our services on our website.


Role Description

We are seeking a highly analytical and computationally proficient individual to join our team with a strong research background. You will be instrumental in contributing to this role by either crafting challenging and insightful problems in your respective research domain, devising elegant computational solutions.


Offer Details:

  • Pay: $1500 per month (Net/take-home)
  • Mode of work - Fully Remote


Responsibilities:

  • Build multi-agent benchmark tasks that require multi-step mathematical reasoning, proof construction, or algorithmic problem-solving
  • Design problems that are genuinely hard for a single agent but decomposable — competition math, numerical analysis, combinatorial optimization, statistical inference
  • Create verification scripts that check mathematical correctness — numerical answers with appropriate tolerance, proof step validity, algorithm output correctness
  • Write clear problem statements with precise notation, definitions, and output format
  • Create decomposition guides that split problems into independent sub-computations or parallel solution strategies


Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years in mathematics, quantitative research, or computational science — competition math, university-level mathematics, or quantitative research background Python programming — NumPy, SciPy, or symbolic computation (SymPy) Experience writing mathematical proofs or formal derivations.
  • Ability to create problems with precise, verifiable answers — not subjective or open-ended.
  • Experience with AI coding benchmarks (SWE-bench, Terminal-bench) Comfortable with Docker — writing Dockerfiles, building images, and debugging container issues.
  • Understanding of numerical methods — floating point tolerance, convergence criteria, error bounds.


Strong plus:  

  • Experience creating math competition problems (AMC, AIME, Putnam, IMO, or similar). 
  • Research in mathematics, theoretical CS, or quantitative fields. 
  • Experience with automated theorem proving or formal verification. 
  • Knowledge of AI reasoning benchmarks (GSM8K, MATH, AIME, GPQA, ARC-AGI). 
  • Experience with large-scale numerical computation or scientific computing


Example of what you will produce:

A task requiring analysis of a system of 50 coupled differential equations modeling a chemical reaction network. The agent must determine equilibrium concentrations, stability conditions, and bifurcation points. Input includes the reaction network as a matrix, rate constants, and initial conditions. The verifier checks numerical answers with tolerance (1e-6), validates eigenvalue analysis for stability, and confirms bifurcation parameter ranges. The decomposition splits into 4 sub-agents: one computes equilibria, one analyzes local stability, one maps bifurcations, and one synthesizes the phase portrait. Oracle scores 1.0, single-agent scores 0.25, multi-agent scores 0.80.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: 8 hours per day with a 4-hour overlap with PST.
  • Employment Type: Contractor position (Note: this role does not include medical/paid leave).
  • Duration of Contract: 6months (expected start date is next week).


How to Apply?

Please send us your updated CV to with job ID 75046 in the email subject line.

Cloud & Infrastructure Management
